title: Pumpkin and Almond Pasta Candies
subtitle: with sage butter
description: Fresh egg pasta rolled around a roasted pumpkin, ricotta and almond filling and twisted like sweets, then tossed in sage butter and served with parmesan.

steps.text: Make the dough: knead the flour, eggs and salt in a mixer with the dough hook (or by hand) until smooth. Wrap in cling film and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 180°C. Spread the diced pumpkin in a single layer on a tray greased with olive oil, sprinkle with coarse salt and brown sugar, tuck in the sage leaves and roast for 40 minutes.
Discard the sage and blitz the roasted pumpkin in a food processor with the ricotta, parmesan, almond meal, salt and pepper until smooth. Transfer to a piping bag.
Roll the dough into a long thin sheet with a pasta machine, lay it on a floured surface and cut into 5 x 10 cm rectangles. Brush with beaten egg.

Place each rectangle with the long side towards you, pipe a little filling in the middle of the bottom part and roll it away from you. Pinch the dough on both sides of the filling and twist closed like a sweet wrapper.
Cook the pasta candies in boiling salted water for 3 to 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the butter with the sage in a wide pan. Add the cooked candies with a little pasta water, cook together for 1 to 2 minutes shaking the pan, and serve with grated parmesan.
